productArea.name: Attributes
productArea.scope: Find and manage product, customer, and model attributes using type filters, creation forms, input settings, values, validation, and storefront options. Assigning attributes to types and editing attribute values on individual records belong to those other areas.

entryPoints.directions: Open an attribute to edit its input settings and values, or choose Create attribute.
Choose Product attributes, Customer attributes, or Model attributes to open the corresponding filtered list.
Choose Create attribute from an attribute list.
